summary: KT Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing its shareholder return policy for FY2026-FY2028. The policy targets a payout of 50% of adjusted stand-alone annual net income via cash dividends and treasury share buyback cancellations. Non-cash/non-recurring items are excluded. The policy is subject to change based on business/market conditions. This is a capital return plan, not a single buyback tender; it functions as a multi-year commitment resembling a US capital allocation disclosure. Watch for execution cadence and any future revisions reflecting performance.
